name: DataTable
description: A versatile, customizable table for displaying structured data with features like sorting, pagination, column width control, row selection with bulk actions, filtering, and an 'add item' action button.
usage: Define your columns using `ColumnDef<YourDataType>[]`. Specify `accessorKey` and `header`.
Use `cell` for custom rendering and `meta: { width: '...' }` for column width.
Enable row selection with `enableRowSelection={true}` and provide `getRowId={(row) => row.uniqueId}`.
Define `selectionActions: DataTableSelectionAction<TData>[]` for bulk operations on selected rows.
Define `addAction: DataTableAddAction` for a primary 'Add Item' button.
Use `statusMessage` to display messages (error, warning, success, info) above the table.
design: Use clear and concise `header` text for columns.
Leverage `cell` rendering for status indicators, badges, or action buttons.
Ensure action buttons (`selectionActions`, `addAction`, `utilityActions`) have clear labels and appropriate icons/variants.
Use `statusMessage` sparingly for important table-level feedback.
accessibility: Pagination controls are implemented as accessible buttons.
Row selection uses standard checkboxes associated with rows.
Status messages provide feedback to assistive technologies.
Action buttons follow standard button accessibility practices.
Ensure custom `cell` renderers maintain accessibility (e.g., proper labels for interactive elements).

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of column definitions using TanStack Table's ColumnDef type.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of data objects to display in the table.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the main table container.

props.name: showPagination
props.description: Whether to display pagination controls below the table.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Number of rows to display per page when pagination is enabled.

props.name: statusMessage
props.description: Object { type: 'error'|'warning'|'success'|'info'|'default', message: string } to display a status message.

props.name: selectionActions
props.description: Array of actions available when rows are selected.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Function to extract a unique ID from a row object (required if `enableRowSelection` is true).

props.name: addAction
props.description: Configuration for the primary 'Add Item' action button.

props.name: utilityActions
props.description: Array of secondary utility action buttons.

props.name: filterGroups
props.description: Configuration for filter groups and options.

auxiliaryTypes.name: ColumnMeta
auxiliaryTypes.description: Used within ColumnDef.meta to control properties like width.

props.name: message
props.description: The text content of the message.

auxiliaryTypes.name: FilterOption
auxiliaryTypes.description: Defines a single filter choice within a FilterGroup.

props.name: column
props.description: The data column (accessorKey/id) to apply the filter to.

props.name: label
props.description: Display label for the filter group.

auxiliaryTypes.name: DataTableSelectionAction<TData>
auxiliaryTypes.description: Defines an action button shown when rows are selected.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback function receiving selected row data.

auxiliaryTypes.name: DataTableUtilityAction
auxiliaryTypes.description: Defines secondary action buttons shown in the action bar.
